research_status: Controlled temperature sensitivity plus climate-informed scenario
soc_profile_interpretation: Repository-provided simulated residential PV-BESS annual SOC profile

temperature_experiments.Miami: Repository hourly Miami temperature profile; 5.0 to 35.6 degrees Celsius

controlled_variable: The SOC trajectory is held identical across temperature cases.
boundary_policy: Do not silently repeat the source profile with its 29.2-percentage-point annual boundary jump. Construct and document a transition to the initial SOC.
important_boundaries: The application SOC profile is repository-provided and simulated.
The Miami temperature file is climate-informed but is not site-matched to the California SOC profile.
The work isolates modeled temperature sensitivity; it is not an empirical lifetime validation.
No aged second-life initial condition is applied yet.
